title: The strict scalar cone and coefficient restriction
statement: For sheaves R,S of commutative rings on a site and a ring map φ:R→S, use the module sheaf categories and restriction along φ. For a compatible global scalar t of R, scalar multiplication is a natural endomorphism of the identity; apply it termwise to cochain complexes. Define C_t(P) as its mapping cone, with action on maps given diagonally and inclusion the unshifted summand. The coefficient map R→Res S sends each local scalar a to φ(a). These are the existing constructions, moved verbatim to a common module.

source.place: Tags 06YP, 06YS, 06YY and Modules on Sites, Tag 03EK; normalized principal quotient construction.

proof.text: Construct the scalar action sectionwise; compatibility of t with restrictions and linearity prove naturality. Map the natural endomorphism through complexes and take Mathlib mapping cones and diagonal maps. Mapping-cone functoriality proves the identity and composition laws. Its inr maps give the natural inclusion.
